verdict.rationale: Omnara's own docs say users can configure which agent actions require approval. That implies actions can run without confirmation, but the evidence never explicitly shows an auto-approve-all mode. missing for 10: explicit documentation of an approve-all/no-confirmation setting, config syntax or examples for approval policies, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can configure an agent to auto-approve all its actions instead of confirming each one

citations.quote: You can decide which actions need approval
